hypotheses.hypothesis: Branch on key[0]==0 creates measurable timing difference between zero and nonzero first byte.
hypotheses.test_vector_hint: Run 10000 calls with key[0]=0x00 (class A) vs key[0]=0xFF (class B), measure delta.
hypotheses.evidence: mean_A=219.9556ns vs mean_B=200.2618ns, t_statistic=93.7, significant=true across 10000 runs.
hypotheses.next_test_hint: Sweep all 256 values of key[0] to build a full timing profile.
exploitation_path: Collect 10000 timing samples per candidate byte value (256 classes).
Compute mean timing per class; identify the class with minimum timing (matches secret byte).
Repeat for each byte position to recover the full key byte-by-byte.
Validate recovered key by running check_key() and verifying return value.
Escalate to full key recovery using Welch t-test across all byte positions.
